custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The "New Inventory Part" window opens.
  • The switch labelled "Track quantities and cost of goods" is on (blue).
  • Directly below the Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge fields is a heading "Inventory Tracking" with an info icon.
  • Under the heading come the switch, then the Min and Max fields, and only then the Tags field.

Step 2:

  • The window closes and no part is created.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10817 (Story 4, Create an Untracked Part), story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S4-R1: “The New Inventory Part dialog has a "Track quantities and cost of goods" switch, on by default.”
  • S4-R2: “The switch sits in its own section headed "Inventory Tracking", below the cost, Sell Price and Core Charge fields, and above Tags (S13-R4).”
  • S4-R4: “Min and Max sit in the section, under the switch.”
  • S13-R1: “The dialog is titled "New Inventory Part" when creating a part and "Edit Inventory Part" when editing one.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "1.1 New Inventory Part opens". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Inventory Tracking sits below the cost, Sell Price and Core Charge fields and above Tags, with the switch on by default (S4-R1, S4-R2). Min and Max sit under the switch (S4-R4).”
